section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 6. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.2 | 6.1 | 200 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 13.6 | 6.8 | 200 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
